null_rule.formula: For each confirmed-track row, if at least two finite current candidates satisfy raw_geometry <= 0.9, and the second-smallest frozen association cost is <= 0.97 with (c2-c1) <= 0.05, set every legal edge to nextafter(0.97,+inf) so the frozen 0.97 assignment threshold abstains. No labels or unknown flags are used online.
null_rule.abstention_cost_semantics: 0.97 is the frozen Hungarian match threshold; it is the fixed cost of declining an ambiguous association, not a physical NULL label.

online_information_boundary: Both arms use current frozen DINO384 proposal embeddings, current detector boxes/scores and strictly past native FIFO memory only. Physical labels are opened only after both arm predictions and hashes are complete.
scope: Six-video native current-only replay of one fixed observable ambiguity/NULL abstention rule against a matched no-rule control. This is a candidate-set boundary experiment, not a tuned final method or novelty claim.
decision_gate: Report all six videos and both arms. Do not select or tune a threshold from outer metrics; a replay can only establish whether this predeclared rule changes native outputs and whether any aggregate gain survives the matched control.
